retry_contract.admission: Only the HTTPError raised by opener.open for the exact fixed HTTPS RPC URL, native integer HTTP 500, unambiguous JSON/identity framing and complete strict UTF-8 JSON body <=8192 bytes containing exactly code/message/details/hint with string native code 55P03 and specified field types. Duplicate keys/nonfinite JSON, partial/oversized/trickling body and response-stream exceptions fail closed.
retry_contract.deadline_limit: One shared deadline and reduced subsequent socket timeouts; the pre-existing outstanding blocked socket read can extend wall-clock time. No hard 15-second wall-clock guarantee.
retry_contract.identity: One serialization and the same Request bytes, headers, endpoint, operation, claim, provider body and cursor across permitted resends.
not_retry_evidence: Errors reading an already opened successful response
retry_contract.remote_error_disclosure: Remote message/details/hint are discarded and never logged or propagated. Exhaustion uses a fixed sanitized reason.
retry_contract.scope_preserved: No worker/provider loop replay, provider refetch, new credential/endpoint/grant/configuration, lease or fence bypass, schedule or restart-policy change. Each resend traverses the existing authentication and authority checks.
retry_contract.unknown_outcomes: Remain fatal immediately, including a later ambiguous outcome after an earlier confirmed abort; no automatic replay after a lost commit or reservation ACK.
